annotations.title: How to get the full paid Launch Verdict

description: Free. Returns the URL, price ($0.01) and x402 payment details for the full Launch Verdict of a token or pool, and whether it is in the index. It does not pay or take any key; the caller pays with its own x402 client.

token_or_pool_id.description: Token address (0x + 40 hex) or Uniswap v4 pool id (0x + 64 hex), as listed by recent_launches.
